title: Qualify affine temperature conversion parity in exact quantities under net10/net11
commitMessage: test: qualify Math temperature parity on net10 and net11

contribution.summary: Verify exact Celsius/Fahrenheit temperature point and interval conversions across net10/C#14 and net11/C#15.
contribution.value: Compile nine unchanged quantities sources in two isolated offline SDK10 and SDK11 consumers; assert canonical freezing point, interval scaling and refusal of invalid temperature arithmetic. Require identical deterministic results and leave production SDK, package archives and M8 state untouched.
debtChanges: RS238 succeeded first-pass at attempt 001 for canonical exact parser and invalid-input refusal parity.
RS239 qualifies bounded affine temperature semantics; it does not certify published package binaries, all numerical behavior or Linux runtime compatibility.
contribution.nextAction: Qualify independent released package consumers under net10/net11 or a separately evidenced Linux runtime gate before migration promotion.
